name: Cash In Hand Report
sql_query:
SELECT dDate, no, transaction, dr_amount, cr_amount,
       SUM(dr_amount - cr_amount) OVER (ORDER BY sort_key, dDate, no, id) AS balance
FROM (
    -- Opening balance: cash before the From date
    SELECT 0 AS sort_key, 0 AS id, :from AS dDate, '' AS no,
           'Opening Balance' AS transaction,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(t.dr_amount - t.cr_amount), 0), 0) AS dr_amount,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(t.cr_amount - t.dr_amount), 0), 0) AS cr_amount
    FROM t_account_trans t
    WHERE t.BC = :bc AND t.AccCode = :account AND t.Ddate < :from

    UNION ALL

    -- Every cash movement in the period
    SELECT 1, t.id, t.Ddate,
           REPLACE(t.trance_no, '-CASH_PAYMENT', ''),
           CASE t.trance_type
               WHEN 'SALES_INVOICE_RECEIPT'     THEN 'Sales'
               WHEN 'SALES_INVOICE'             THEN 'Sales'
               WHEN 'SALE_PAYMENT'              THEN 'Sales'
               WHEN 'CUSTOMER_PAYMENT'          THEN 'Customer Payment'
               WHEN 'CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_RECEIPT'  THEN 'Customer Payment'
               WHEN 'CUSTOMER_ADVANCE'          THEN 'Customer Advance'
               WHEN 'CUSTOMER_ADVANCE_RECEIPT'  THEN 'Customer Advance'
               WHEN 'CUSTOMER_CHEQUE_PASS'      THEN 'Customer Cheque Realized'
               WHEN 'CUSTOMER_CHEQUE_RETURN'    THEN 'Customer Cheque Returned'
               WHEN 'HP_DOWN_PAYMENT'           THEN 'HP Down Payment'
               WHEN 'HP_AGREEMENT'              THEN 'HP Down Payment'
               WHEN 'HP_INSTALLMENT'            THEN 'HP Installment'
               WHEN 'HP_PENALTY'                THEN 'HP Penalty'
               WHEN 'HP_RETURN_REFUND'          THEN 'HP Return Refund'
               WHEN 'SALE_RETURN'               THEN 'Sales Return Refund'
               WHEN 'SALE_RETURN_REFUND'        THEN 'Sales Return Refund'
               WHEN 'SERVICE_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT'  THEN 'Service Payment'
               WHEN 'SERVICE_INVOICE'           THEN 'Service Payment'
               WHEN 'SERVICE_SUPPLIER_PAYMENT'  THEN 'Service Supplier Payment'
               WHEN 'SUPPLIER_PAYMENT'          THEN 'Supplier Payment'
               WHEN 'PURCHASE_PAYMENT'          THEN 'Supplier Payment'
               WHEN 'SUPPLIER_CHEQUE_PASS'      THEN 'Supplier Cheque Realized'
               WHEN 'PAYMENT_VOUCHER'           THEN 'Payment Voucher'
               WHEN 'EXPENSE'                   THEN 'Expenses'
               WHEN 'BANK_ENTRY'                THEN 'Bank Deposit / Withdrawal'
               ELSE REPLACE(t.trance_type, '_', ' ')
           END,
           t.dr_amount, t.cr_amount
    FROM t_account_trans t
    WHERE t.BC = :bc AND t.AccCode = :account
      AND t.Ddate BETWEEN :from AND :to
) cash
ORDER BY sort_key, dDate, no, id;
